chars: Yea, hath God said, Ye shall not eat of every tree of the garden?
God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
Why art thou wroth? and why is thy countenance fallen? If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted?
I know not: Am I my brother's keeper?
Come thou and all thy house into the ark; for thee have I seen righteous before me in this generation.
I do set my bow in the cloud, and it shall be for a token of a covenant between me and the earth.
Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name.
Get thee out of thy country, and from thy kindred, and from thy father's house, unto a land that I will shew thee.
Let there be no strife, I pray thee, between me and thee; for we be brethren.
Look now toward heaven, and tell the stars, if thou be able to number them: So shall thy seed be.
Hagar, Sarai's maid, whence camest thou? and whither wilt thou go?
Sarah thy wife shall have a son.
Wherefore did Sarah laugh? Is any thing too hard for the LORD?
Escape for thy life; look not behind thee.
God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.
My father: Behold the fire and the wood: but where is the lamb?
My son, God will provide himself a lamb.
Drink, my lord: I will draw water for thy camels also.
Feed me, I pray thee, with that same red pottage; for I am faint.
Sell me this day thy birthright.
For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.
The voice is Jacob's voice, but the hands are the hands of Esau.
Bless me, even me also, O my father.
Behold, I am with thee, and will keep thee in all places whither thou goest.
Surely the LORD is in this place; and I knew it not.
Return unto the land of thy fathers, and I will be with thee.
The LORD watch between me and thee, when we are absent one from another.
I will not let thee go, except thou bless me.
Thy name shall be called no more Jacob, but Israel: for as a prince hast thou power with God and with men.
Behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
Behold, this dreamer cometh. Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit.
Do not interpretations belong to God? tell me them, I pray you.
